label: end-of-episode / low-value unit (late trials, not on reward or S1 inputs)
explanation: Fires only in the last ~15 trials of the 100-trial episode (zero activity before trial ~78; 45% of steps in trials 90-99, 93% of mass) and so tracks the model's value-head output dropping as the episode runs out: 97% of mass is at value < 5.22, none at value >= 7.13. Inside that window the unit is gated by the current input. It never fires on a step whose reward input is 1 (D1 after a rewarded trial) and rarely fires when the S1 state is shown at D2. It is strongest at GO (73% of mass), especially when the agent is about to choose a2 or the good state is S2: the top windows are long streaks of a2 -> S2 common rewarded, with activation growing trial by trial toward the end of the episode. Magnitude grows as the episode end nears (as value falls) and is larger at GO than at D2. It does not depend on the transition type or on the core pattern (equal rates across all four). The predicate uses only the model's own value plus current inputs, no future variables. ep_trial >= 90 with the same input gates gives F1 0.73. Precision is incomplete: some low-value D1/D2 steps after a1/S1 are not active, and some GO steps at moderate value are missed.
